quests.objective: Report Daewyn's fate to Dorin Songblade in Lakeshire.

Alcaz Prison.description: Long rumored to hold high-ranking prisoners, including King Varian Wrynn, the prison on Alcaz Island has been out of reach until now. Inside, the Defias Brotherhood and the naga are at war. Known bosses so far: Blazeroar.

entrance.detail: Northern Badlands: through the excavation cave north of Angor Fortress to the stone door at the back
entrance.label: Uldaman Entrance

bosses.name: Revelosh
bosses.description: In the cave before Ironaya's chamber. Drops The Shaft of Tsol for Staff of Prehistoria.

bosses.name: The Lost Dwarves
bosses.description: Baelog, Eric "The Swift" and Olaf, fought together in Dig Two. Horde only: they are friendly to the Alliance.

bosses.name: Ironaya
bosses.description: In the Map Chamber. Use the Staff of Prehistoria on the altar to open her door.

bosses.name: Ancient Stone Keeper
bosses.description: In the Temple Hall.

bosses.name: Galgann Firehammer
bosses.description: In the Dig Three area, past the Shadowforge dwarves.

bosses.name: Grimlok
bosses.description: Trogg leader in the Stone Vault. Drops the sapphire for the necklace quests.

bosses.name: Archaedas
bosses.description: Final boss, in the Chamber of Khaz'Mul. Use the altar to wake him. Drops the power source for the necklace quests.

Uldaman.description: An ancient titan vault buried beneath the Badlands, overrun by troggs and Shadowforge dwarves. Archaedas guards the Discs of Norgannon in its deepest chamber.

quests.name: The Lost Dwarves
quests.note: Introductory step leading to The Hidden Chamber.
quests.pickup: Prospector Stormpike, Hall of Explorers, Ironforge
quests.objective: Find Baelog in Uldaman.

quests.name: The Hidden Chamber
quests.note: Optional introductory quest:
quests.objective: Read Baelog's Journal, explore the hidden chamber, then report to Prospector Stormpike.

quests.name: A Sign of Hope
quests.objective: Find Hammertoe Grez in Uldaman.

quests.name: Amulet of Secrets
quests.turnin: Hammertoe Grez, Uldaman excavation (outside the instance)
quests.pickup: Hammertoe Grez, Uldaman excavation (outside the instance)
quests.objective: Find Hammertoe's Amulet and return it to him in Uldaman.

quests.name: Ironband Wants You!
quests.note: Introductory step leading to Agmond's Fate.
quests.turnin: Prospector Ironband, Ironband's Excavation Site, Loch Modan
quests.pickup: Prospector Stormpike, Hall of Explorers, Ironforge
quests.objective: Speak with Prospector Ironband at Ironband's Excavation Site in Loch Modan.

quests.name: Agmond's Fate
quests.note:
The urns are in the outer Uldaman cave, before the instance portal.

Optional introductory quest:
quests.objective: Bring 4 Carved Stone Urns to Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan.

quests.name: Uldaman Reagent Run
quests.objective: Bring 12 Magenta Fungus Caps to Ghak Healtouch in Thelsamar.

quests.name: Uldaman Reagent Run
quests.objective: Bring 12 Magenta Fungus Caps to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath.

quests.name: Solution to Doom
quests.objective: Bring the Tablet of Ryun'eh to Theldurin the Lost.

quests.name: Power Stones
quests.note: The power stones drop from Shadowforge dwarves in the outer cave.
quests.objective: Bring 8 Dentrium Power Stones and 8 An'Alleum Power Stones to Rigglefuzz in the Badlands.

quests.name: Reclaimed Treasures
quests.objective: Get Krom Stoutarm's treasured possession from his chest in the North Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in Ironforge.

quests.name: Reclaimed Treasures
quests.objective: Get Patrick Garrett's family treasure from their family chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in the Undercity.

quests.name: The Lost Tablets of Will
quests.objective: Find the Tablet of Will, and return them to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.

quests.name: Back to Uldaman
quests.objective: Search for clues as to the current disposition of Talvash's necklace within Uldaman. The slain paladin he mentioned was the person who has it last.

quests.name: Find the Gems
quests.note: The sapphire drops from Grimlok.
quests.objective: Find the ruby, sapphire, and topaz that are scattered throughout Uldaman. Once acquired, contact Talvash del Kissel remotely by using the Phial of Scrying he previously gave you.

quests.name: Restoring the Necklace
quests.note: The power source drops from Archaedas. Finishing it unlocks Talvash's Enhancing Necklace.
quests.objective: Obtain a power source from the most powerful construct you can find in Uldaman, and deliver it to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.

quests.name: Necklace Recovery
quests.objective: Look for a valuable necklace within the Uldaman dig site and bring it back to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar. The necklace may be damaged.

quests.name: Necklace Recovery, Take 2
quests.objective: Find a clue as to the gems' whereabouts in the depths of Uldaman.

quests.name: Find the Gems and Power Source
quests.note: The sapphire drops from Grimlok and the power source from Archaedas.
quests.objective: Recover all three gems and a power source for the necklace from Uldaman, and then bring them to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath. Jarkal believes a power source might be found on the strongest construct present in Uldaman.

quests.name: The Platinum Discs
quests.note: The discs are in the Map Chamber, past Ironaya.
quests.objective: Speak with stone watcher and learn what ancient lore it keeps. Once you have learned what lore it has to offer, activate the Discs of Norgannon.
startObject: In the Map Chamber beyond Archaedas, inside Uldaman

quests.name: The Platinum Discs
quests.note: Speak with the Stone Watcher and activate the discs first. Then hand the reward voucher to Dinita Stonemantle in the Ironforge vault and choose your reward.
quests.objective: Take the miniature version of the Discs of Norgannon to the Explorers' League in Ironforge.
startObject: In the Map Chamber beyond Archaedas, inside Uldaman

quests.name: The Platinum Discs
quests.note: Speak with the Stone Watcher and activate the discs first. Then hand the reward voucher to Bena Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff and choose your reward.
quests.objective: Take the miniature version of the Discs of Norgannon to the one of the sages in Thunder Bluff.
startObject: In the Map Chamber beyond Archaedas, inside Uldaman

quests.name: Power in Uldaman
quests.note: Mage class quest. The Obsidian Sentinel guards the back entrance of Uldaman. Continues with Mana Surges for the Celestial Orb or Celestial Stave.
quests.objective: Retrieve an Obsidian Power Source and bring it to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

entrance.detail: Central Feralas, inside the ruins of Eldre'Thalas: the West wing door, opened with the Crescent Key
entrance.label: Dire Maul Entrance

bosses.name: Tendris Warpwood
bosses.description: Treant guarding the Capital Gardens.

bosses.name: Illyanna Ravenoak
bosses.description: Hunter with her bear Ferra, on the pylon terraces.

bosses.name: Tsu'zee
bosses.description: Rare spawn, stealthed in the Capital Gardens.

bosses.name: Magister Kalendris
bosses.description: Shadow priest on the pylon terraces.

bosses.name: Immol'thar
bosses.description: Demon in the Prison of Immol'thar; the force field drops once all five pylons are shut down.

bosses.name: Lord Hel'nurath
bosses.description: Summoned by warlocks in the pentagram near Immol'thar (Dreadsteed of Xoroth).

bosses.name: Prince Tortheldrin
bosses.description: Final boss, in the Athenaeum. Drops the Gauntlet of Gordok Might for Unfinished Gordok Business.

Dire Maul: West.description: The Capital Gardens and the Court of the Highborne, where the last Shen'dralar keep the demon Immol'thar imprisoned behind five pylons. Needs the Crescent Key from Pusillin.

quests.name: The Madness Within
quests.note: Kill the guardians of all five pylons, then Immol'thar, then Prince Tortheldrin. Return to the Ancient, take The Treasure of the Shen'dralar and open the chest under the library stairs for the reward.
quests.objective: You must destroy the guardians surrounding the 5 Pylons that power the Prison of Immol'thar. Once the Pylons have powered down, the force field surrounding Immol'thar will have dissipated. Enter the Prison of Immol'thar and eradicate the foul demon that stands at its heart. Finally, confront Prince Tortheldrin in Athenaeum. Return to the Shen'dralar Ancient in the courtyard should you complete this quest.

quests.name: Elven Legends
quests.note: Interact with the Skeletal Remains of Telmius Dreamseeker beside Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum. Unlocks Lydros's libram exchanges.
quests.objective: Search Dire Maul for Kariel Winthalus. Report back to Sage Korolusk at Camp Mojache with whatever information that you may find.

quests.name: Elven Legends
quests.note: Interact with the Skeletal Remains of Telmius Dreamseeker beside Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum. Unlocks Lydros's libram exchanges.
quests.objective: Search Dire Maul for Kariel Winthalus. Report back to Scholar Runethorn at Feathermoon with whatever information that you may find.

quests.name: Starfall
quests.note: Introductory step leading to Fragments of the Past.
quests.objective: Find Starfall in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.

quests.name: Fragments of the Past
quests.note:
Fill her vial at the dire pool along Eldreth Row in Dire Maul West; also bring 1 Enchanted Thorium Bar and 5 Crystal Restore.

Optional introductory quest:
quests.pickup: Aurora Skycaller, Northpass Tower, Eastern Plaguelands
quests.objective: Bring an Enchanted Thorium Bar, 5 Crystal Restore, and a Vial of Dire Water to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
quests.turnin: Aurora Skycaller, Northpass Tower, Eastern Plaguelands

quests.name: Ancient Equine Spirit
quests.note: Paladin charger quest. Kill Tendris Warpwood, then feed the Ancient Equine Spirit and give it the Arcanite Barding. Bring the Manna-Enriched Horse Feed from Merideth Carlson in Southshore.
quests.pickup: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker, Cathedral of Light, Stormwind
quests.objective: Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse. Merideth Carlson in Southshore apparently is the source for such food. Travel to the Dire Maul dungeon in Feralas and slay Tendris Warpwood. Doing so will free the Ancient Equine Spirit. Feed it the special horse feed, thereby soothing the spirit. Finally, give it the Arcanite Barding so it may bless it.

quests.name: Unfinished Gordok Business
quests.note: West objective: the Gauntlet of Gordok Might is in a chest near Prince Tortheldrin. The quest itself comes from a friendly Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul North after you become the Gordok king.
quests.objective: Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul. According to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings.

quests.name: Dreadsteed of Xoroth
quests.note: Warlock dreadsteed quest. After Immol'thar dies, run the ritual in his prison with J'eevee's Jar, the Black Lodestone and the Xorothian Glyphs. Bring Soul Shards.
quests.pickup: Mor'zul Bloodbringer, Altar of Storms, Burning Steppes
quests.objective: Read Mor'zul's Instructions. Summon a Xorothian Dreadsteed, defeat it, then bind its spirit to you.

entrance.detail: Far south of the Barrens, at the border with Thousand Needles: through the thorny tunnel to the entrance
entrance.label: Razorfen Downs Entrance

bosses.name: Tuten'kash
bosses.description: Spider boss. Ring the gong on the Spiral of Thorns to summon him.

bosses.name: Mordresh Fire Eye
bosses.description: In the room with the bone pile and the floating skulls.

bosses.name: Glutton
bosses.description: On the path up the Downs, after Mordresh.

bosses.name: Ragglesnout
bosses.description: Rare spawn, near the top of the Downs. No special loot.

bosses.name: Plaguemaw the Rotting
bosses.description: Rare spawn, in the cave below the bridge. No special loot.

bosses.name: Amnennar the Coldbringer
bosses.description: Final boss, at the top of the Downs. Drops the Skull of the Coldbringer for Bring the End.

Razorfen Downs.description: The ancient burial grounds of the quilboar, now held by the Scourge. Amnennar the Coldbringer leads the undead from the top of the Downs.

quests.name: Extinguishing the Idol
quests.note: Waves of undead attack during the ritual. Talk to the brazier near the idol afterwards to finish.
quests.objective: Escort Belnistrasz to the Quilboar's idol in Razorfen Downs. Protect Belnistrasz while he performs the ritual to shut down the idol.

quests.name: A Host of Evil
quests.note: These mobs are outside the instance, around the entrance.
quests.pickup: Myriam Moonsinger, Razorfen Downs thorn maze, The Barrens
quests.objective: Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.
quests.turnin: Myriam Moonsinger, Razorfen Downs thorn maze, The Barrens

quests.name: Bring the End
quests.objective: Andrew Brownell wants you to kill Amnennar the Coldbringer and return his skull.

quests.name: Bring the Light
quests.objective: Archbishop Benedictus wants you to slay Amnennar the Coldbringer in Razorfen Downs.

quests.name: An Unholy Alliance
quests.note: Ambassador Malcin is in the tents of the outdoor thorn maze, before the instance portal. Starts from the Small Scroll dropped by Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul.
quests.objective: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.

entrance.detail: Central Feralas, inside the ruins of Eldre'Thalas: the East wing is reached through the Broken Commons and the gate on the east side
entrance.label: Dire Maul Entrance

bosses.name: Zevrim Thornhoof
bosses.description: Satyr at the sacrificial altar in the Warpwood Quarter.

bosses.name: Hydrospawn
bosses.description: Water elemental in the pool below the bridge.

bosses.name: Lethtendris
bosses.description: Blood elf with her pet Pimgib, in the room before Alzzin. Drops Lethtendris's Web.

bosses.name: Alzzin the Wildshaper
bosses.description: Final boss, deep in the Warpwood Quarter.

Dire Maul: East.description: The eastern quarter of the ruined Highborne city of Eldre'Thalas, overgrown by the Warpwood and ruled by the satyr Alzzin the Wildshaper. Pusillin carries the Crescent Key that opens the other wings.

quests.name: Pusillin and the Elder Azj'Tordin
quests.note: Chase and talk to Pusillin through the wing until he fights, then kill him for the book. He also drops the Crescent Key.
quests.objective: Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary. Return to Azj'Tordin at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas should you recover the Book of Incantations.

quests.name: Feathermoon Stronghold
quests.note: Introductory step leading to Lethtendris's Web.
quests.pickup: Crier Goodman, Stormwind (or Courier Hammerfall, Ironforge / Herald Moonstalker, Darnassus)
quests.objective: Speak with Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

quests.name: Lethtendris's Web
quests.note:
The web drops from Lethtendris.

Optional introductory quest:
quests.objective: Bring Lethtendris' Web to Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

quests.name: Camp Mojache
quests.note: Introductory step leading to Lethtendris's Web.
quests.pickup: Harbinger Balthazad, Undercity (or Warcaller Gorlach, Orgrimmar / Bluff Runner Windstrider, Thunder Bluff)
quests.objective: Speak with Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

quests.name: Lethtendris's Web
quests.note:
The web drops from Lethtendris.

Optional introductory quest:
quests.objective: Bring Lethtendris's Web to Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

quests.name: Shards of the Felvine
quests.note: Kill Alzzin the Wildshaper, pick up a Felvine Shard near the vine and seal it in the Reliquary of Purity.
quests.objective: Find the Felvine in Dire Maul and acquire a shard from it. Chances are you'll only be able to procure one with the demise of Alzzin the Wildshaper. Use the Reliquary of Purity to securely seal the shard inside, and return it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

quests.name: Arcane Refreshment
quests.note: Mage class quest. Lydros is in the Athenaeum (North/West); Hydrospawn Essence drops from Hydrospawn in East. Rewards Conjure Water (Rank 7).
quests.objective: Travel to the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul and slay the water elemental, Hydrospawn. Return to Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum with the Hydrospawn Essence.

entrance.detail: Inside the Scarlet Monastery; the Armory door needs The Scarlet Key from the Library
entrance.label: Scarlet Monastery Entrance

Scarlet Monastery: Armory.description: The armory wing of the Scarlet Monastery, where the Crusade drills its recruits under the eye of Herod, the Scarlet Champion. The door is locked: you need The Scarlet Key from the Library.

bosses.name: Herod
bosses.description: Final boss, in the Hall of Champions. When he dies a wave of Scarlet Trainees rushes in.

bosses.name: Trash Drops
loot: Scarlet Monastery trash (Chain of the Scarlet Crusade)

quests.name: Into The Scarlet Monastery
quests.note: Herod is in the Armory; Loksey in the Library; Mograine and Whitemane in the Cathedral.
quests.objective: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Varimathras in the Undercity.

quests.name: Brother Anton
quests.note: Introductory step leading to In the Name of the Light.
quests.pickup: Brother Crowley, Cathedral of Light, Stormwind
quests.objective: Speak with Brother Anton in Desolace.

quests.name: In the Name of the Light
quests.note:
Herod is in the Armory; Loksey in the Library; Mograine and Whitemane in the Cathedral.

Optional introductory quest:
quests.objective: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Raleigh the Devout in Southshore.

quests.name: Hearts of Zeal
quests.note: Monastery-wide collection: any Scarlet humanoid on the way to the Armory can drop Hearts of Zeal.
quests.objective: Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity wants 20 Hearts of Zeal.

bosses.description: Rare ogre in the Spirestone area before Highlord Omokk.

bosses.name: Spirestone Battle Lord
bosses.description: Rare ogre near Highlord Omokk.

bosses.name: Spirestone Lord Magus
bosses.description: Rare ogre caster near Highlord Omokk.

bosses.name: Highlord Omokk
bosses.description: Spirestone ogre chief on the ledge in Hordemar City. Drops the Gemstone of Spirestone.

bosses.name: Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin
bosses.description: Smolderthorn troll shadow hunter on the way to Voone.

bosses.name: War Master Voone
bosses.description: Smolderthorn troll leader in Mok'Doom. Drops the Gemstone of Smolderthorn.

bosses.name: Mother Smolderweb
bosses.description: Spider queen in the Skitterweb Tunnels. Get poisoned for Mother's Milk.

bosses.name: Crystal Fang
bosses.description: Rare spider in the Skitterweb Tunnels.

bosses.name: Urok Doomhowl
bosses.description: Summoned at his pike with Warosh's quest items, along with waves of ogres.

bosses.name: Bannok Grimaxe
bosses.description: Rare Firebrand champion near the Storehouse.

bosses.name: Quartermaster Zigris
bosses.description: In the Storehouse, guarded by Bloodaxe ogres.

bosses.name: Halycon
bosses.description: Bloodaxe worg pack mistress in her den. Gizrul comes out after she dies.

bosses.name: Gizrul the Slavener
bosses.description: Comes for you shortly after Halycon dies.

bosses.name: Ghok Bashguud
bosses.description: Rare Bloodaxe champion on the bridge to Wyrmthalak.

bosses.name: Overlord Wyrmthalak
bosses.description: Final boss: Bloodaxe overlord in the Chamber of Battle; calls two Bloodaxe Veterans at low health. Drops the Gemstone of Bloodaxe.

Lower Blackrock Spire.description: The lower halls of Blackrock Spire, held by the Spirestone, Smolderthorn and Bloodaxe clans of the Dark Horde under Overlord Wyrmthalak.

quests.note: Carry an Unadorned Seal of Ascension (a Spire trash drop) to Vaelan. The gemstones drop from Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone and Overlord Wyrmthalak.
quests.objective: Find the three gemstones of command: the Gemstone of Smolderthorn, Gemstone of Spirestone and Gemstone of Bloodaxe. Return them, along with the Unadorned Seal of Ascension, to Vaelan. The generals are War Master Voone of the Smolderthorn, Highlord Omokk of the Spirestone and Overlord Wyrmthalak of the Bloodaxe.

quests.name: Bijou's Belongings
quests.note: Bijou hides in a recess beyond the early bridges. Her belongings spawn in one of several places around the troll and orc rooms.
quests.objective: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. Good luck!

quests.name: Bijou's Belongings
quests.note: Then take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report to Lexlort in Kargath for the reward.
quests.objective: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.

quests.name: Maxwell's Mission
quests.turnin: Marshal Maxwell, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes
quests.pickup: Marshal Maxwell, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.

quests.name: Warlord's Command
quests.note: Talk to Goretooth to receive his Command item and click it to start the quest. The Important Blackrock Documents spawn near the three generals.
quests.objective: Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.

quests.name: Put Her Down
quests.note: Kill Halycon, the worg den mother. Be ready for Gizrul the Slavener, who comes for you right after.
quests.turnin: Helendis Riverhorn, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes
quests.pickup: Helendis Riverhorn, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy the source of the worg menace. As you left Helendis, he shouted a name: Halycon. It is what the orcs refer to in regards to the worg.

quests.name: The Pack Mistress
quests.note: Kill Halycon, the worg den mother. Be ready for Gizrul the Slavener, who comes for you right after.
quests.objective: Slay Halycon, pack mistress of the Bloodaxe worg.

quests.name: Kibler's Exotic Pets
quests.note: Use the supplied cage on a Bloodaxe Worg Pup in the worg area.
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Bloodaxe Worg Pups. Use the cage to carry the ferocious little beasts. Bring back a Caged Worg Pup to Kibler.

quests.name: En-Ay-Es-Tee-Why
quests.note: Spire Spider Eggs are in the spider tunnels.
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs for Kibler. By the sound of it, these eggs could be found near spiders.

quests.name: Mother's Milk
quests.note: Get poisoned by Mother Smolderweb and reach Ragged John while still poisoned. Don't let anyone cleanse it.
quests.pickup: Ragged John, Flame Crest, Burning Steppes
quests.objective: In the heart of Blackrock Spire you will find Mother Smolderweb. Engage her and get her to poison you. Return to Ragged John while poisoned so that he can 'milk' you.
quests.turnin: Ragged John, Flame Crest, Burning Steppes

quests.name: Urok Doomhowl
quests.note: Bring Highlord Omokk's Head and a Roughshod Pike to Urok's Tribute Pile beyond the spiders to start the waves.
quests.objective: Read Warosh's Scroll. Bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.

quests.name: General Drakkisath's Command
quests.note: Leads to General Drakkisath's Demise in Upper Blackrock Spire.
quests.turnin: Marshal Maxwell, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes
quests.pickup: General Drakkisath's Command (drops from Overlord Wyrmthalak)
quests.objective: Take General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell in Burning Steppes.

quests.name: The Final Tablets
quests.note: The fifth and sixth Mosh'aru tablets are in the Smolderthorn troll area. Continues with Confront Yeh'kinya and The Hand of Rastakhan.
quests.objective: Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

entrance.detail: Dungeon entrance in the Ruins of Lordaeron
entrance.label: Ruins of Lordaeron Entrance

Ruins of Lordaeron.description: Scourge forces still haunt the ruined capital while a necromancer gathers power within the city.

frFR.title: Itinéraire Alliance vers les Ruines de Lordaeron
frFR.subtitle: Itinéraire Alliance

steps.title: Allez au port de Hurlevent
steps.text: Allez au port de Hurlevent et prenez le bateau pour Auberdine. À votre arrivée, rendez-vous de l'autre côté des quais d'Auberdine et montez à bord du navire pour le port de Menethil. Ne descendez pas à Menethil, restez sur le même navire, il continuera jusqu'à Southshore dans les contreforts de Hautebrande.

map.detail: Le bateau pour Auberdine part du quai le plus au sud, quai 1, au port de Hurlevent.
map.label: Bateau pour Auberdine, port de Hurlevent

steps.text: Quittez Southshore et suivez la route vers les champs de Hautebrande. De là, continuez vers le nord en direction de Dalaran.
steps.title: Suivez la route depuis Southshore
Contournez Dalaran
steps.text: Continuez vers le nord et contournez Dalaran jusqu'au lac Lordamere. Il n'est pas nécessaire d'entrer dans Dalaran.

steps.title: Nagez vers le nord dans le lac Lordamere
steps.text: Traversez le lac Lordamere vers le nord, depuis la région de la forêt des Pins argentés jusqu'aux Clairières de Tirisfal.

steps.title: Suivez la route vers Fossoyeuse
steps.text: Une fois dans les Clairières de Tirisfal, suivez la route vers Fossoyeuse. En entrant dans Fossoyeuse, tournez à gauche et montez les escaliers, l'entrée du donjon se trouve là.

esES.title: Ruta de la Alianza a las Ruinas de Lordaeron
esES.subtitle: Ruta de la Alianza

steps.title: Ve al Puerto de Ventormenta
steps.text: Ve al Puerto de Ventormenta y toma el barco a Auberdine. Al llegar, ve al lado opuesto de los muelles de Auberdine y sube al barco hacia el Puerto de Menethil. No bajes en Menethil, quédate en el mismo barco, continuará hasta Costasur en las Laderas de Trabalomas.

map.detail: El barco a Auberdine sale del muelle más al sur, muelle 1, del Puerto de Ventormenta.
map.label: Barco a Auberdine, Puerto de Ventormenta

steps.text: Sal de Costasur y sigue el camino hacia los Campos de Trabalomas. Desde allí, continúa hacia el norte en dirección a Dalaran.
steps.title: Sigue el camino desde Costasur
Rodea Dalaran
steps.text: Continúa hacia el norte y rodea Dalaran hasta llegar al Lago Lordamere. No necesitas entrar en Dalaran.

steps.title: Nada al norte por el Lago Lordamere
steps.text: Nada hacia el norte por el Lago Lordamere, pasando desde la zona del Bosque de Argénteos hasta los Claros de Tirisfal.

steps.title: Sigue el camino hacia Entrañas
steps.text: Cuando llegues a los Claros de Tirisfal, sigue el camino hacia Entrañas. Cuando entres en Entrañas, gira a la izquierda y sube las escaleras, allí está la entrada de la mazmorra.

zhCN.title: 联盟前往洛丹伦废墟的路线
zhCN.subtitle: 联盟路线

steps.title: 前往暴风城港口
steps.text: 在暴风城港口乘船前往奥伯丁。抵达后，前往奥伯丁码头的另一侧，登上前往米奈希尔港的船。不要在米奈希尔港下船，留在同一艘船上，它会继续驶往希尔斯布莱德丘陵的南海镇。

map.detail: 前往奥伯丁的船从暴风城港口最南端的1号码头出发。
map.label: 前往奥伯丁的船，暴风城港口

steps.text: 离开南海镇，沿着道路前往希尔斯布莱德农场。从那里继续向北前往达拉然。
steps.title: 从南海镇沿路前进
绕过达拉然
steps.text: 继续向北，绕过达拉然直到抵达洛丹米尔湖。无需进入达拉然。

steps.title: 向北游过洛丹米尔湖
steps.text: 向北游过洛丹米尔湖，从银松森林一带进入提瑞斯法林地。

steps.title: 沿路前往幽暗城
steps.text: 抵达提瑞斯法林地后，沿着道路前往幽暗城。进入幽暗城后，向左转并上楼，那里就是副本入口。

zhTW.title: 聯盟前往洛丹倫廢墟的路線
zhTW.subtitle: 聯盟路線

steps.title: 前往暴風城港口
steps.text: 在暴風城港口乘船前往奧伯丁。抵達後，前往奧伯丁碼頭的另一側，登上前往米奈希爾港的船。不要在米奈希爾港下船，留在同一艘船上，它會繼續駛往希爾斯布萊德丘陵的南海鎮。

map.detail: 前往奧伯丁的船從暴風城港口最南端的1號碼頭出發。
map.label: 前往奧伯丁的船，暴風城港口

steps.text: 離開南海鎮，沿著道路前往希爾斯布萊德農場。從那裡繼續向北前往達拉然。
steps.title: 從南海鎮沿路前進
繞過達拉然
steps.text: 繼續向北，繞過達拉然直到抵達洛丹米爾湖。無需進入達拉然。

steps.title: 向北遊過洛丹米爾湖
steps.text: 向北遊過洛丹米爾湖，從銀松森林一帶進入提里斯法林地。

steps.title: 沿路前往幽暗城
steps.text: 抵達提里斯法林地後，沿著道路前往幽暗城。進入幽暗城後，向左轉並上樓，那裡就是副本入口。

ptBR.title: Rota da Aliança até as Ruínas de Lordaeron
ptBR.subtitle: Rota da Aliança

steps.title: Vá ao Porto de Ventobravo
steps.text: Vá ao Porto de Ventobravo e pegue o navio para Auberdine. Ao chegar, vá para o lado oposto das docas de Auberdine e embarque no navio para o Porto de Menethil. Não desça em Menethil, permaneça no mesmo navio, ele seguirá até Costa Sul, no Contraforte de Eira dos Montes.

map.detail: O navio para Auberdine parte do cais mais ao sul, Cais 1, no Porto de Ventobravo.
map.label: Navio para Auberdine, Porto de Ventobravo

steps.text: Saia de Costa Sul e siga a estrada em direção aos Campos de Eira dos Montes. De lá, continue para o norte em direção a Dalaran.
steps.title: Siga a estrada saindo de Costa Sul
Contorne Dalaran
steps.text: Continue para o norte e contorne Dalaran até chegar ao Lago Lordamere. Não é necessário entrar em Dalaran.

steps.title: Nade para o norte pelo Lago Lordamere
steps.text: Nade para o norte pelo Lago Lordamere, passando da região da Floresta de Pinhaprata até as Clareiras de Tirisfal.

steps.title: Siga a estrada até a Cidade Baixa
steps.text: Ao chegar às Clareiras de Tirisfal, siga a estrada em direção à Cidade Baixa. Ao entrar na Cidade Baixa, vire à esquerda e suba as escadas, a entrada da masmorra fica ali.

steps.title: 스톰윈드 항구로 이동
steps.text: 스톰윈드 항구에서 아우버다인행 배를 타세요. 도착하면 아우버다인 부두 반대편으로 가서 메네실 항구행 배에 탑승하세요. 메네실 항구에서 내리지 말고 그대로 타고 있으면 힐스브래드 구릉지의 사우스쇼어까지 계속 갑니다.

map.detail: 아우버다인행 배는 스톰윈드 항구의 가장 남쪽 부두인 1번 부두에서 출발합니다.
map.label: 아우버다인행 배, 스톰윈드 항구

steps.text: 사우스쇼어를 떠나 힐스브래드 농장 방향으로 길을 따라가세요. 그곳에서 북쪽으로 달라란을 향해 계속 이동하세요.
steps.title: 사우스쇼어에서 길 따라가기
달라란 우회하기
steps.text: 북쪽으로 계속 가서 로데미어 호수에 도착할 때까지 달라란을 돌아가세요. 달라란에 들어갈 필요는 없습니다.

steps.title: 로데미어 호수를 헤엄쳐 북쪽으로
steps.text: 로데미어 호수를 가로질러 북쪽으로 헤엄치면 은빛소나무 숲 지역에서 티리스팔 숲으로 넘어갑니다.

steps.title: 언더시티로 가는 길 따라가기
steps.text: 티리스팔 숲에 도착하면 언더시티 방향으로 길을 따라가세요. 언더시티에 들어서면 왼쪽으로 돌아 계단을 올라가면 던전 입구가 있습니다.

deDE.title: Allianz-Route zu den Ruinen von Lordaeron
deDE.subtitle: Allianz-Route

steps.title: Zum Hafen von Sturmwind
steps.text: Gehe zum Hafen von Sturmwind und nimm das Schiff nach Auberdine. Dort angekommen, geh auf die gegenüberliegende Seite der Auberdine-Docks und steig auf das Schiff nach Menethil. Steig in Menethil nicht aus, bleib auf demselben Schiff, es fährt weiter nach Süderstade im Vorgebirge des Hügellands.

map.detail: Das Schiff nach Auberdine legt am südlichsten Steg, Dock 1, im Hafen von Sturmwind ab.
map.label: Schiff nach Auberdine, Hafen von Sturmwind

steps.text: Verlasse Süderstade und folge der Straße in Richtung Hügellandhöfe. Von dort aus geh weiter nach Norden in Richtung Dalaran.
steps.title: Folge der Straße von Süderstade
Um Dalaran herum
steps.text: Gehe weiter nach Norden und um Dalaran herum, bis du den Lordameresee erreichst. Du musst Dalaran nicht betreten.

steps.title: Durch den Lordameresee nach Norden schwimmen
steps.text: Schwimme nach Norden durch den Lordameresee, vom Silberwald aus bis in die Tirisfalglades.

steps.title: Folge der Straße nach Unterstadt
steps.text: Sobald du die Tirisfalglades erreichst, folge der Straße in Richtung Unterstadt. Wenn du Unterstadt betrittst, geh nach links und die Treppe hinauf, dort befindet sich der Dungeoneingang.

steps.title: Отправляйтесь в гавань Штормграда
steps.text: Отправляйтесь в гавань Штормграда и сядьте на корабль до Аубердина. Прибыв в Аубердин, перейдите на противоположную сторону пристани и сядьте на корабль до гавани Менетилов. В Менетиле не выходите, оставайтесь на том же корабле, он продолжит путь до Южнобережья в Предгорьях Хилсбрада.

map.detail: Корабль в Аубердин отправляется от самого южного причала, причал 1, в гавани Штормграда.
map.label: Корабль в Аубердин, гавань Штормграда

steps.text: Покиньте Южнобережье и следуйте по дороге к Хилсбрадским полям. Оттуда продолжайте двигаться на север в сторону Даларана.
steps.title: Следуйте по дороге из Южнобережья
Обойдите Даларан
steps.text: Продолжайте двигаться на север и обойдите Даларан, пока не достигнете озера Лордамер. Заходить в Даларан не нужно.

steps.title: Плывите на север через озеро Лордамер
steps.text: Плывите на север через озеро Лордамер, из Серебряного бора в Тирисфальские леса.

steps.title: Следуйте по дороге в Подгород
steps.text: Добравшись до Тирисфальских лесов, следуйте по дороге к Подгороду. Войдя в Подгород, поверните налево и поднимитесь по лестнице, там находится вход в подземелье.

enUS.title: Alliance Route to Ruins of Lordaeron
enUS.subtitle: Alliance route

steps.title: Go to Stormwind Harbor
steps.text: Head to Stormwind Harbor and take the boat to Auberdine. Once you arrive, go to the opposite side of the Auberdine docks and board the ship to Menethil Harbor. Do not get off at Menethil Harbor, stay on the same ship and it will continue to Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

map.detail: The Auberdine ship leaves from the southernmost dock, Dock 1, in Stormwind Harbor.
map.label: Auberdine Ship, Stormwind Harbor

steps.text: Leave Southshore and follow the road toward Hillsbrad Fields. From there, continue north toward Dalaran.
steps.title: Follow the road from Southshore
Pass around Dalaran
steps.text: Continue north and go around Dalaran until you reach Lordamere Lake. You do not need to enter Dalaran.

steps.title: Swim north through Lordamere Lake
steps.text: Swim north across Lordamere Lake, passing from the Silverpine area into Tirisfal Glades.

steps.title: Follow the road to Undercity
steps.text: Once you reach Tirisfal Glades, follow the road toward Undercity. Once you enter Undercity, turn left and go upstairs, there's the dungeon entrance.

itIT.title: Percorso dell'Alleanza verso le Rovine di Lordaeron
itIT.subtitle: Percorso Alleanza

steps.title: Vai al Porto di Roccavento
steps.text: Vai al Porto di Roccavento e prendi la nave per Auberdine. Una volta arrivato, vai sul lato opposto dei moli di Auberdine e sali sulla nave diretta al Porto di Menethil. Non scendere a Menethil, resta sulla stessa nave, proseguirà fino a Southshore nelle Alture di Colletorto.

map.detail: La nave per Auberdine parte dal molo più a sud, Molo 1, del Porto di Roccavento.
map.label: Nave per Auberdine, Porto di Roccavento

steps.text: Lascia Southshore e segui la strada verso i Campi di Hillsbrad. Da lì, continua verso nord in direzione di Dalaran.
steps.title: Segui la strada da Southshore
Passa attorno a Dalaran
steps.text: Continua verso nord e passa attorno a Dalaran finché non raggiungi il Lago Lordamere. Non è necessario entrare a Dalaran.

steps.title: Nuota verso nord nel Lago Lordamere
steps.text: Nuota verso nord attraverso il Lago Lordamere, passando dalla zona di Selva Pinargento alle Radure di Tirisfal.

steps.title: Segui la strada verso Sepulcra
steps.text: Quando raggiungi le Radure di Tirisfal, segui la strada verso Sepulcra. Una volta entrato a Sepulcra, gira a sinistra e sali le scale, lì si trova l'ingresso della spedizione.

quests.name: The Pariah's Instructions
quests.note: Loot the Amulet of Spirits from the Nameless Prophet in the outer caves, then use it to fight the five Khans: three in the outer caves, one on the purple route and one on the orange route. Combine their gems with the amulet.
quests.objective: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.

quests.name: Shadowshard Fragments

frFR.title: Itinéraire Horde vers la Salle des thanes
frFR.subtitle: Itinéraire Horde

steps.title: Si vous n'êtes pas Mort-vivant, prenez le zeppelin d'Orgrimmar à Fossoyeuse

map.detail: Le zeppelin pour Fossoyeuse s'amarre à la tour devant Orgrimmar. Demandez à Frezza en cas de doute.
map.label: Zeppelin pour Fossoyeuse

steps.title: Fossoyeuse -> forêt des Pins argentés -> Moulin-de-Tarren
steps.text: Partez de Fossoyeuse, dirigez-vous vers le sud à travers les Clairières de Tirisfal et la forêt des Pins argentés, puis continuez jusque dans les Contreforts de Hautebrande jusqu'à atteindre Moulin-de-Tarren.

steps.title: Moulin-de-Tarren -> Hautes-terres d'Arathi
steps.text: Suivez la route vers l'est jusqu'aux Hautes-terres d'Arathi, puis continuez vers le sud en direction du grand pont de pierre.

steps.title: Pont de Thandol (Hautes-terres d'Arathi / Paluns)
steps.text: Cet immense pont traverse la gorge vers les Paluns et constitue votre passage vers le territoire de l'Alliance.

steps.title: Paluns
steps.text: Restez sur la route principale en direction du sud-est. C'est l'itinéraire le plus sûr, alors suivez-la jusqu'au bout.

steps.title: Dun Algaz (Paluns / Loch Modan)
steps.text: Ce col de montagne mène à Loch Modan. Des gardes de l'Alliance se trouvent au poste de contrôle, alors continuez à courir et traversez sans vous arrêter.

steps.title: Loch Modan -> Dun Morogh
steps.text: Dirigez-vous vers l'ouest jusqu'au tunnel qui relie Loch Modan à Dun Morogh. Passez la porte et continuez vers l'ouest en direction de Forgefer.

steps.title: Avant d'entrer dans Forgefer (Dun Morogh)
steps.text: Retirez votre équipement. Les gardes vous tueront probablement plusieurs fois, et l'équipement non porté ne perd pas de durabilité.

steps.title: Forgefer
steps.text: Allez au Haut Siège, la salle du trône du roi Magni. En entrant, prenez le couloir couvert de toiles d'araignée sur votre gauche, aux coordonnées 43.5, 52.0.

steps.title: Course en fantôme
steps.text: Le Gardien des âmes se trouve juste à l'extérieur de la ville, donc chaque mort ne demande qu'un court trajet de retour. Ressuscitez dans des coins calmes, hors de vue des gardes, afin de progresser à chaque tentative.

steps.title: Vieille Forgefer
steps.text: Suivez les escaliers sinueux et les chemins de pierre vers le bas. Le chemin se termine sur un pont au-dessus de la lave, où se trouvent le donneur de quête Thom Filch et le portail du donjon.

esES.title: Ruta de la Horda a la Sala de los Thanes
esES.subtitle: Ruta de la Horda

steps.title: Si no eres no-muerto, toma el zepelín de Orgrimmar a Entrañas

map.detail: El zepelín a Entrañas atraca en la torre fuera de Orgrimmar. Pregunta a Frezza si no sabes cuál es.
map.label: Zepelín a Entrañas

steps.title: Entrañas -> Bosque de Argénteos -> Molino Tarren
steps.text: Viaja hacia el sur desde Entrañas a través de Claros de Tirisfal y del Bosque de Argénteos, y después continúa hasta las Laderas de Trabalomas hasta llegar a Molino Tarren.

steps.title: Molino Tarren -> Tierras Altas de Arathi
steps.text: Sigue el camino hacia el este hasta las Tierras Altas de Arathi y después continúa hacia el sur en dirección al gran puente de piedra.

steps.title: Puente Thandol (Tierras Altas de Arathi / Los Humedales)
steps.text: Este enorme puente cruza el desfiladero hasta Los Humedales y es tu entrada al territorio de la Alianza.

steps.title: Los Humedales
steps.text: Mantente en el camino principal hacia el sudeste. Es la ruta más segura, así que síguela durante todo el trayecto.

steps.title: Dun Algaz (Los Humedales / Loch Modan)
steps.text: Este paso de montaña lleva a Loch Modan. Hay guardias de la Alianza en el puesto de control, así que sigue corriendo y atraviesa la zona sin detenerte.

steps.title: Loch Modan -> Dun Morogh
steps.text: Ve hacia el oeste hasta el túnel que conecta Loch Modan con Dun Morogh. Cruza la puerta y continúa hacia el oeste en dirección a Forjaz.

steps.title: Antes de entrar en Forjaz (Dun Morogh)
steps.text: Quítate el equipo. Es probable que los guardias te maten varias veces, y el equipo que no llevas puesto no pierde durabilidad.

steps.title: Forjaz
steps.text: Ve al Alto Asiento, la sala del trono del rey Magni. Al entrar, toma el pasillo cubierto de telarañas a tu izquierda, en las coordenadas 43.5, 52.0.

steps.title: Correr desde el cadáver
steps.text: El Ángel de la Resurrección está justo fuera de la ciudad, así que cada muerte implica un trayecto corto de vuelta. Resucita en rincones tranquilos fuera de la vista de los guardias para avanzar un poco más cada vez.

steps.title: Antigua Forjaz
steps.text: Sigue las escaleras sinuosas y los caminos de piedra hacia abajo. El camino termina en un puente sobre lava, donde están el encargado de misión Thom Filch y el portal de la mazmorra.

zhCN.title: 部落前往领主之厅的路线
zhCN.subtitle: 部落路线

steps.title: 如果你不是亡灵，请从奥格瑞玛乘坐飞艇前往幽暗城

map.detail: 前往幽暗城的飞艇停靠在奥格瑞玛外的飞艇塔。如果不确定是哪一艘，可以询问弗雷扎。
map.label: 前往幽暗城的飞艇

steps.title: 幽暗城 -> 银松森林 -> 塔伦米尔
steps.text: 从幽暗城出发向南穿过提瑞斯法林地和银松森林，然后进入希尔斯布莱德丘陵，直到抵达塔伦米尔。

steps.title: 塔伦米尔 -> 阿拉希高地
steps.text: 沿着道路向东进入阿拉希高地，然后沿路向南前往那座巨大的石桥。

steps.title: 萨多尔大桥（阿拉希高地 / 湿地交界）
steps.text: 这座巨大的桥横跨峡谷通往湿地，是你进入联盟领土的门户。

steps.title: 湿地
steps.text: 沿着向东南方向的主路前进。道路是最安全的路线，请一路沿路走。

steps.title: 丹奥加兹（湿地 / 洛克莫丹交界）
steps.text: 这条山口通往洛克莫丹。检查站有联盟守卫，不要停下，靠速度冲过去。

steps.title: 洛克莫丹 -> 丹莫罗
steps.text: 向西前往连接洛克莫丹和丹莫罗的隧道。穿过大门后继续向西前往铁炉堡。

steps.title: 进入铁炉堡之前（丹莫罗）
steps.text: 脱下你的装备。你很可能会被守卫杀死几次，而未装备的物品不会损失耐久度。

steps.title: 铁炉堡
steps.text: 前往国王麦格尼的王座厅——大王座。进入时走左边被蜘蛛网覆盖的走廊，坐标 43.5, 52.0。

steps.title: 跑尸
steps.text: 灵魂医者就在城外，所以每次死亡只需跑一小段路。在守卫看不到的僻静角落复活，这样每次都能向前推进。

steps.title: 旧铁炉堡
steps.text: 沿着蜿蜒的楼梯和石路向下走。道路尽头是熔岩上的一座桥，任务发布者汤姆·菲尔奇和副本传送门就在那里。

map.detail: 前往幽暗城的飛艇停靠在奧格瑪外的飛艇塔。如果不確定是哪一艘，可以詢問弗雷扎。
map.label: 前往幽暗城的飛艇

steps.title: 幽暗城 -> 銀松森林 -> 塔倫米爾
steps.text: 從幽暗城出發向南穿過提里斯法林地和銀松森林，然後進入希爾斯布萊德丘陵，直到抵達塔倫米爾。

steps.title: 塔倫米爾 -> 阿拉希高地
steps.text: 沿著道路向東進入阿拉希高地，然後沿路向南前往那座巨大的石橋。

steps.title: 薩多爾大橋（阿拉希高地 / 濕地交界）
steps.text: 這座巨大的橋橫跨峽谷通往濕地，是你進入聯盟領土的門戶。

steps.title: 濕地
steps.text: 沿著向東南方向的主路前進。道路是最安全的路線，請一路沿路走。

steps.title: 丹奧加茲（濕地 / 洛克莫丹交界）
steps.text: 這條山口通往洛克莫丹。檢查站有聯盟守衛，不要停下，靠速度衝過去。

steps.title: 洛克莫丹 -> 丹莫洛
steps.text: 向西前往連線洛克莫丹和丹莫洛的隧道。穿過大門後繼續向西前往鐵爐堡。

steps.title: 進入鐵爐堡之前（丹莫洛）
steps.text: 脫下你的裝備。你很可能會被守衛殺死幾次，而未裝備的物品不會損失耐久度。

steps.title: 鐵爐堡
steps.text: 前往國王麥格尼的王座廳——大王座。進入時走左邊被蜘蛛網覆蓋的走廊，座標 43.5, 52.0。

steps.title: 跑屍
steps.text: 靈魂醫者就在城外，所以每次死亡只需跑一小段路。在守衛看不到的僻靜角落復活，這樣每次都能向前推進。

steps.title: 舊鐵爐堡
steps.text: 沿著蜿蜒的樓梯和石路向下走。道路盡頭是熔岩上的一座橋，任務釋出者湯姆·菲爾奇和副本傳送門就在那裡。

ptBR.title: Rota da Horda até o Salão dos Thanes
ptBR.subtitle: Rota da Horda

steps.title: Se você não é Morto-vivo, pegue o zepelim de Orgrimmar para Cidade Baixa

map.detail: O zepelim para Cidade Baixa atraca na torre fora de Orgrimmar. Pergunte a Frezza se não tiver certeza de qual é.
map.label: Zepelim para Cidade Baixa

steps.title: Cidade Baixa -> Floresta de Pinhaprata -> Moinho Tarren
steps.text: Siga para o sul saindo da Cidade Baixa, atravesse as Clareiras de Tirisfal e a Floresta de Pinhaprata, e então continue até o Contraforte de Eira dos Montes até chegar ao Moinho Tarren.

steps.title: Moinho Tarren -> Planalto Arathi
steps.text: Siga pela estrada para leste até o Planalto Arathi e depois continue para o sul em direção à grande ponte de pedra.

steps.title: Ponte Thandol (Planalto Arathi / Pantanal)
steps.text: Essa enorme ponte atravessa o desfiladeiro até o Pantanal e é a sua entrada em território da Aliança.

steps.title: Pantanal
steps.text: Permaneça na estrada principal seguindo para sudeste. A estrada é o caminho mais seguro, então siga por ela o trajeto inteiro.

steps.title: Dun Algaz (Pantanal / Loch Modan)
steps.text: Essa passagem nas montanhas leva a Loch Modan. Há guardas da Aliança no posto de controle, então continue correndo e atravesse sem parar.

steps.title: Loch Modan -> Dun Morogh
steps.text: Siga para oeste até o túnel que liga Loch Modan a Dun Morogh. Passe pelo portão e continue para oeste em direção a Altaforja.

steps.title: Antes de entrar em Altaforja (Dun Morogh)
steps.text: Retire seu equipamento. Os guardas provavelmente vão matar você algumas vezes, e equipamentos não equipados não perdem durabilidade.

steps.title: Altaforja
steps.text: Vá até o Alto Assento, a sala do trono do Rei Magni. Ao entrar, pegue o corredor coberto de teias de aranha à esquerda, nas coordenadas 43.5, 52.0.

steps.title: Corrida de cadáver
steps.text: O Anjo da Cura fica logo do lado de fora da cidade, então cada morte exige apenas uma corrida curta de volta. Ressuscite em cantos tranquilos fora da visão dos guardas para avançar um pouco mais a cada tentativa.

steps.title: Velha Altaforja
steps.text: Siga as escadas sinuosas e os caminhos de pedra para baixo. O caminho termina em uma ponte sobre a lava, onde ficam o entregador de missão Thom Filch e o portal da masmorra.

steps.title: 언데드가 아니라면 오그리마에서 언더시티행 비행선을 타세요

map.detail: 언더시티행 비행선은 오그리마 외곽의 탑에 정박합니다. 어느 비행선인지 모르겠다면 프레짜에게 물어보세요.
map.label: 언더시티행 비행선

steps.title: 언더시티 -> 은빛소나무 숲 -> 타렌 밀
steps.text: 언더시티에서 티리스팔 숲과 은빛소나무 숲을 지나 남쪽으로 이동한 뒤, 힐스브래드 구릉지로 들어가 타렌 밀까지 가세요.

steps.title: 타렌 밀 -> 아라시 고원
steps.text: 길을 따라 동쪽으로 아라시 고원에 들어간 뒤, 큰 돌다리를 향해 남쪽으로 따라가세요.

steps.title: 탄돌 교 (아라시 고원 / 저습지 경계)
steps.text: 이 거대한 다리는 협곡을 건너 저습지로 이어지며, 얼라이언스 영토로 들어가는 관문입니다.

steps.title: 저습지
steps.text: 남동쪽으로 향하는 큰길을 따라가세요. 길이 가장 안전하니 끝까지 길을 벗어나지 마세요.

steps.title: 던 알가즈 (저습지 / 모단 호수 경계)
steps.text: 이 산길은 모단 호수로 이어집니다. 검문소에 얼라이언스 경비병이 있으니 멈추지 말고 속도로 통과하세요.

steps.title: 모단 호수 -> 던 모로
steps.text: 모단 호수와 던 모로를 잇는 터널로 서쪽으로 가세요. 관문을 계속 지나 아이언포지를 향해 서쪽으로 이동하세요.

steps.title: 아이언포지에 들어가기 전 (던 모로)
steps.text: 장비를 벗으세요. 경비병에게 몇 번 죽을 가능성이 높은데, 착용하지 않은 장비는 내구도가 닳지 않습니다.

steps.title: 아이언포지
steps.text: 마그니 왕의 알현실인 왕좌로 가세요. 들어가면서 왼쪽의 거미줄로 덮인 통로(좌표 43.5, 52.0)로 들어가세요.

steps.title: 시체 찾기
steps.text: 영혼의 치유사가 도시 바로 밖에 있어서 죽을 때마다 조금만 달리면 됩니다. 경비병 눈에 띄지 않는 조용한 구석에서 부활해 매번 조금씩 전진하세요.

steps.title: 옛 아이언포지
steps.text: 구불구불한 계단과 돌길을 따라 아래로 내려가세요. 길 끝에는 퀘스트 제공자 톰 필치와 던전 입구가 있는 용암 위의 다리가 있습니다.

steps.title: Wenn du kein Untoter bist, nimm den Zeppelin von Orgrimmar nach Unterstadt

map.detail: Der Zeppelin nach Unterstadt legt am Turm vor Orgrimmar an. Frag Frezza, wenn du dir nicht sicher bist, welcher es ist.
map.label: Zeppelin nach Unterstadt

steps.title: Unterstadt -> Silberwald -> Tarrens Mühle
steps.text: Reise von Unterstadt nach Süden durch die Tirisfal und den Silberwald und weiter ins Vorgebirge des Hügellands, bis du Tarrens Mühle erreichst.

steps.title: Tarrens Mühle -> Arathihochland
steps.text: Reite auf der Straße nach Osten ins Arathihochland und folge ihr dann nach Süden bis zur großen Steinbrücke.

steps.title: Thandol-Übergang (Arathihochland / Sumpfland)
steps.text: Diese riesige Brücke führt über die Schlucht ins Sumpfland und ist dein Zugang in Allianzgebiet.

steps.title: Sumpfland
steps.text: Bleib auf der Hauptstraße und folge ihr nach Südosten. Die Straße ist der sicherste Weg, also bleib ihr die ganze Strecke treu.

steps.title: Dun Algaz (Sumpfland / Loch Modan)
steps.text: Dieser Gebirgspass führt nach Loch Modan. Am Kontrollpunkt stehen Allianz-Wachen, also lauf einfach weiter und versuche, ohne anzuhalten durchzukommen.

steps.title: Loch Modan -> Dun Morogh
steps.text: Reite nach Westen zum Tunnel, der Loch Modan mit Dun Morogh verbindet. Lauf durch das Tor und weiter nach Westen in Richtung Eisenschmiede.

steps.title: Vor dem Betreten von Eisenschmiede (Dun Morogh)
steps.text: Zieh deine Ausrüstung aus. Die Wachen werden dich wahrscheinlich ein paar Mal töten, und nicht angelegte Ausrüstung verliert keine Haltbarkeit.

steps.title: Eisenschmiede
steps.text: Geh zum Hohen Sitz, König Magnis Thronsaal. Wenn du hineingehst, nimm links den mit Spinnweben bedeckten Korridor bei den Koordinaten 43.5, 52.0.

steps.title: Leichenlauf
steps.text: Der Geistheiler steht direkt außerhalb der Stadt, daher ist der Rückweg nach jedem Tod kurz. Belebe dich in ruhigen Ecken außerhalb der Sicht der Wachen wieder, damit du jedes Mal etwas weiterkommst.

steps.title: Alt-Eisenschmiede
steps.text: Folge den gewundenen Treppen und Steinwegen nach unten. Der Weg endet an einer Brücke über Lava, bei der der Questgeber Thom Filch und das Dungeonportal stehen.

steps.title: Если вы не Нежить, отправляйтесь на дирижабле из Оргриммара в Подгород

map.detail: Дирижабль в Подгород причаливает к башне у Оргриммара. Если не уверены, какой нужен, спросите Фреззу.
map.label: Дирижабль в Подгород

steps.title: Подгород -> Серебряный бор -> Мельница Таррен
steps.text: Отправляйтесь на юг из Подгорода через Тирисфальские леса и Серебряный бор, затем продолжайте путь в Предгорья Хилсбрада, пока не доберетесь до Мельницы Таррен.

steps.title: Мельница Таррен -> Нагорье Арати
steps.text: Двигайтесь по дороге на восток в Нагорье Арати, затем следуйте по ней на юг к большому каменному мосту.

steps.title: Мост Тандола (Нагорье Арати / Болотина)
steps.text: Этот огромный мост пересекает ущелье и ведет в Болотину. Здесь начинается территория Альянса.

steps.title: Болотина
steps.text: Держитесь главной дороги и двигайтесь на юго-восток. Это самый безопасный путь, поэтому не сходите с дороги.

steps.title: Дун Альгаз (Болотина / Лок Модан)
steps.text: Этот горный проход ведет в Лок Модан. На заставе стоят стражники Альянса, поэтому продолжайте бежать и постарайтесь пройти ее без остановки.

steps.title: Лок Модан -> Дун Морог
steps.text: Направляйтесь на запад к туннелю, соединяющему Лок Модан и Дун Морог. Пройдите через ворота и продолжайте двигаться на запад к Стальгорну.

steps.title: Перед входом в Стальгорн (Дун Морог)
steps.text: Снимите экипировку. Стражники, скорее всего, убьют вас несколько раз, а снятые предметы не теряют прочность.

steps.title: Стальгорн
steps.text: Направляйтесь в Палату Совета, к тронному залу короля Магни. Войдя внутрь, сверните в покрытый паутиной коридор слева, у координат 43.5, 52.0.

steps.title: Пробежка от кладбища
steps.text: Целитель душ находится прямо у города, поэтому после каждой смерти бежать обратно недалеко. Воскрешайтесь в тихих углах вне поля зрения стражников, чтобы с каждой попыткой продвигаться дальше.

steps.title: Старый Стальгорн
steps.text: Спускайтесь по извилистым лестницам и каменным дорожкам. Путь заканчивается у моста над лавой, где находятся квестодатель Thom Filch и портал в подземелье.

enUS.title: Horde Route to Hall of Thanes
enUS.subtitle: Horde route

steps.title: If you're not Undead, take the Zeppelin from Orgrimmar to Undercity

map.detail: The Undercity zeppelin docks at the tower outside Orgrimmar. Ask Frezza if you're unsure which one it is.
map.label: Zeppelin to Undercity

steps.title: Undercity -> Silverpine Forest -> Tarren Mill
steps.text: Travel south from Undercity through Tirisfal Glades and Silverpine Forest, then continue into Hillsbrad Foothills until you reach Tarren Mill.

steps.title: Tarren Mill -> Arathi Highlands
steps.text: Ride east along the road into Arathi Highlands, then follow it south toward the big stone bridge.

steps.title: Thandol Span (Arathi Highlands / Wetlands border)
steps.text: This huge bridge crosses the gorge into the Wetlands, and it is your gateway into Alliance territory.

steps.title: Wetlands
steps.text: Stay on the main road heading south-east. The road is the safest path, so stick to it all the way.

steps.title: Dun Algaz (Wetlands / Loch Modan border)
steps.text: This mountain pass leads into Loch Modan. Alliance guards stand at the checkpoint, so keep running and let your speed carry you through.

steps.title: Loch Modan -> Dun Morogh
steps.text: Head west to the tunnel that connects Loch Modan to Dun Morogh. Keep moving through the gate and continue west toward Ironforge.

steps.title: Before entering Ironforge (Dun Morogh)
steps.text: Take off your gear. Guards will likely kill you a few times, and unequipped gear takes no durability damage.

steps.title: Ironforge
steps.text: Head to the High Seat, King Magni's throne room. As you walk in, take the spiderweb-covered corridor on your left, at coordinates 43.5, 52.0.

steps.title: Corpse Running
steps.text: The Spirit Healer is right outside the city, so each death means a short run back. Resurrect in quiet corners out of the guards' sight so you gain ground every time.

steps.title: Old Ironforge
steps.text: Follow the winding stairs and stone paths downward. The path ends at a bridge over lava with the quest giver Thom Filch and the dungeon portal.

itIT.title: Percorso dell'Orda verso la Sala dei Thane
itIT.subtitle: Percorso Orda

steps.title: Se non sei un Non Morto, prendi lo zeppelin da Orgrimmar a Sepulcra

map.detail: Lo zeppelin per Sepulcra attracca alla torre fuori da Orgrimmar. Chiedi a Frezza se non sei sicuro di quale sia.
map.label: Zeppelin per Sepulcra

steps.title: Sepulcra -> Selva Pinargento -> Mulino di Tarren
steps.text: Viaggia verso sud da Sepulcra attraverso le Radure di Tirisfal e la Selva Pinargento, poi continua nelle Alture di Colletorto fino a raggiungere il Mulino di Tarren.

steps.title: Mulino di Tarren -> Altopiani d'Arathi
steps.text: Segui la strada verso est fino agli Altopiani d'Arathi, poi prosegui verso sud in direzione del grande ponte di pietra.

steps.title: Ponte di Thandol (Altopiani d'Arathi / Paludi Grigie)
steps.text: Questo enorme ponte attraversa la gola verso le Paludi Grigie ed è il tuo ingresso nel territorio dell'Alleanza.

steps.title: Paludi Grigie
steps.text: Rimani sulla strada principale e prosegui verso sud-est. È il percorso più sicuro, quindi seguilo fino in fondo.

steps.title: Dun Algaz (Paludi Grigie / Loch Modan)
steps.text: Questo passo di montagna conduce a Loch Modan. Al checkpoint ci sono guardie dell'Alleanza, quindi continua a correre e attraversalo senza fermarti.

steps.title: Loch Modan -> Dun Morogh
steps.text: Dirigiti a ovest verso il tunnel che collega Loch Modan a Dun Morogh. Attraversa il cancello e continua a ovest verso Forgiardente.

steps.title: Prima di entrare a Forgiardente (Dun Morogh)
steps.text: Togliti l'equipaggiamento. Le guardie probabilmente ti uccideranno alcune volte e l'equipaggiamento non indossato non perde durabilità.

steps.title: Forgiardente
steps.text: Raggiungi l'Alto Seggio, la sala del trono di Re Magni. Entrando, prendi il corridoio coperto di ragnatele sulla sinistra, alle coordinate 43.5, 52.0.

steps.title: Corsa dal cadavere
steps.text: Il Guaritore Spirituale si trova subito fuori dalla città, quindi dopo ogni morte il tragitto di ritorno è breve. Resuscita negli angoli tranquilli fuori dalla visuale delle guardie per avanzare un po' ogni volta.

steps.title: Vecchia Forgiardente
steps.text: Segui le scale tortuose e i sentieri di pietra verso il basso. Il percorso termina su un ponte sopra la lava, dove si trovano il PNG della missione Thom Filch e il portale del dungeon.
